title: ERROR: .NET: Failed to get GodotPlugins initialization function pointer  5745  5772 E godot : at: initialize_coreclr_and_godot_plugins (modules/mono/mono_gd/gd_mono.cpp:485)
body:
### Tested versions

4.4 stable.mono.official

### System information

Android 13 / Fedora 42

### Issue description

### Steps to reproduce

I'm really not too sure how to reliably reproduce but I welcome debugging suggestions. 

But essentially:
1) Export  an Android .apk as `arm64-v8a` with a target `SDK of 34`
2) Launch the application on android device
3) Close it (Swipe Up)
4) Keep opening and closing until the issue appears.

.
